Title: Verify free shipping for orders $50.00 or more
Preconditions: User has items in cart with subtotal after discounts $50.00 or more
Action: Proceed to checkout and view order summary
Expected: Shipping cost is displayed as $0.00 (free shipping)
QA note: Boundary value $50.00 covers the free-shipping rule.

Title: Verify shipping cost for orders under $50.00
Preconditions: User has items in cart with subtotal after discounts less than $50.00
Action: Proceed to checkout and view order summary
Expected: Shipping cost is displayed as $5.99

Title: Verify shipping cost calculation uses subtotal after discounts
Preconditions: User has items in cart with original subtotal over $50.00 but subtotal after discounts under $50.00
Action: Proceed to checkout and view order summary
Expected: Shipping cost is displayed as $5.99 because subtotal after discounts is under $50.00
Test data: Original subtotal: $60.00, discounts: $15.00, subtotal after discounts: $45.00
QA note: Key case for AC 3: discount moves the order below the threshold.

Title: Verify shipping cost is free when subtotal after discounts equals exactly $50.00
Preconditions: User has items in cart with subtotal after discounts exactly $50.00
Action: Proceed to checkout and view order summary
Expected: Shipping cost is displayed as $0.00 (free shipping)

Title: Verify shipping cost is $5.99 when subtotal after discounts is just below $50.00
Preconditions: User has items in cart with subtotal after discounts $49.99
Action: Proceed to checkout and view order summary
Expected: Shipping cost is displayed as $5.99

Title: Verify shipping cost calculation with zero subtotal
Preconditions: User has an empty cart or subtotal after discounts is $0.00
Action: Proceed to checkout and view order summary
Expected: Shipping cost is displayed as $5.99 since subtotal is under $50.00
QA note: Not reachable: an empty cart is blocked at checkout (US-CHK-05).

Title: Verify tax is applied only to discounted subtotal, excluding shipping
Preconditions: User has items in cart with a discount applied.; User enters a supported state for shipping address.
Action: Calculate the discounted subtotal and shipping cost separately.
Expected: Discounted subtotal and shipping cost are displayed separately.
QA note: No 5% state exists. Changed to TX (8.25%).

Title: Verify tax is applied only to discounted subtotal, excluding shipping
Preconditions: User has items in cart with a discount applied.; User enters a supported state for shipping address.
Action: Proceed to checkout and observe tax calculation.
Expected: Tax is calculated only on the discounted subtotal, shipping cost is not taxed.
QA note: No 5% state exists. Changed to TX (8.25%).

Title: Verify tax is rounded half-up to 2 decimal places
Preconditions: User has items in cart with a discount applied.; User enters a supported state for shipping address with a tax rate that results in a tax with more than 2 decimal places.
Action: Check out with a taxable subtotal of $2.00 shipping to TX (8.25%) and read the tax line.
Expected: Tax is $0.17 ($0.165 rounded half-up).
QA note: AI data ($53.50 at 5% = $2.675) rounds the same way with half-up and banker's rounding, so it cannot catch a rounding bug. Changed to $2.00 in TX: $0.165 must round to $0.17.

Title: Verify checkout is blocked for unsupported states with clear message
Preconditions: User has items in cart.; User enters an unsupported state for shipping address.
Action: Attempt to proceed to checkout with unsupported state selected.
Expected: Checkout is blocked and a clear message is displayed indicating the state is unsupported for tax calculation.

Title: Verify checkout proceeds for supported state with zero discount and tax applied correctly
Preconditions: User has items in cart with no discount applied.; User enters a supported state for shipping address.
Action: Calculate tax on subtotal with zero discount and verify tax calculation and rounding.
Expected: Tax is applied to subtotal only, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places, shipping is not taxed.
QA note: 7.25% is the CA rate. Kept as a manual case.

Title: Verify tax calculation when discounted subtotal is zero
Preconditions: User has items in cart with discount equal to subtotal resulting in zero discounted subtotal.; User enters a supported state for shipping address.
Action: Calculate tax on zero discounted subtotal.
Expected: Tax is $0.00, shipping is not taxed.
QA note: No 6% state exists. Changed to TX. Manual case.

Title: Verify error message when state field is left blank
Preconditions: User has items in cart.; State field is left blank or empty.
Action: Attempt to proceed to checkout without selecting a state.
Expected: Checkout is blocked and a clear message is displayed indicating that state selection is required.
QA note: Manual case. Same rule as TC-US-CHK-04-03.

Title: Verify tax is not applied to shipping when shipping cost is zero
Preconditions: User has items in cart with discount applied.; Shipping cost is zero.; User enters a supported state for shipping address.
Action: Calculate tax and verify that shipping cost zero is not taxed.
Expected: Tax is applied only to discounted subtotal, shipping cost zero does not affect tax calculation.
QA note: No 8% state exists. Changed to TX. Manual case.

Title: Apply a valid percentage discount code
Preconditions: Cart holds 3 x TEE ($60.00 subtotal).
Action: Enter a valid discount code 'SAVE10' (10% off) in the discount code field and click Apply.
Expected: The subtotal is reduced by 10% to $54.00.
Test data: Discount code: SAVE10, Subtotal before discount: $60.00
QA note: Expected result also asserted case-insensitivity (AC 4), which TC-US-CART-02-04 covers. Data aligned with the catalog.

Title: Apply an expired discount code
Preconditions: User has items in the cart.
Action: Enter the expired discount code 'OLD5' and click Apply.
Expected: The system rejects the code and displays the message 'This code has expired'.
QA note: OLD50 does not exist; the expired code is OLD5. Type changed to negative.

Title: Apply a second discount code after one is already applied
Preconditions: User has applied a valid discount code 'SAVE10' to the order.
Action: Enter a second discount code 'OLD5' and click Apply.
Expected: The system rejects the second code and does not change the subtotal. Only one code is applied per order.
Test data: First discount code: SAVE10, Second discount code: OLD5
QA note: SAVE20 does not exist. Second code changed to OLD5. Type changed to negative.

Title: Apply discount code with mixed case letters
Preconditions: User has items in the cart.
Action: Enter a valid discount code 'sAvE10' with mixed case and click Apply.
Expected: The discount code is accepted and the subtotal is reduced by 10%.

Title: Apply an invalid discount code
Preconditions: User has items in the cart.
Action: Enter an invalid discount code 'INVALID' and click Apply.
Expected: The system rejects the code and displays an error message indicating the code is invalid.
QA note: No AC covers invalid codes. Mapped to AC 1 for now; asked the product owner to add an AC. Manual case.

Title: Apply discount code when subtotal is zero
Preconditions: User has items in the cart but subtotal is $0 due to previous discounts or promotions.
Action: Enter a valid discount code 'SAVE10' and click Apply.
Expected: The subtotal remains $0 after applying the discount code.
Test data: Discount code: SAVE10, Subtotal before discount: $0
